create.title: Create knowledge path
create.error: Could not create the knowledge path
create.coverHint: Recommended: a 16:9 image for the best display.
create.guideTitle: How do you create a good path?
create.guideLead: Creating a knowledge path is an exercise in clarity: you are designing the ideal route for someone else to approach a topic step by step.
create.journey1: • In what order should someone approach this topic?
create.journey2: • Are there different levels of complexity for this topic?
create.journey3: • How can they move forward step by step?
create.notJustTitle: It is more than grouping content:
create.notJustBody: A good path is not a list of links. It is a learning experience: each node prepares the next one.
create.questions1: • If you knew nothing about this topic, what would come first?
create.questions2: • Which pieces of content are gems on this topic, and what makes someone ready to appreciate them?
create.closing: Imagine you are designing the ideal map for someone who wants to learn this without getting frustrated or wasting time.
